summary: Merged a Next.js-SaaS fix for a broken pnpm-lock.yaml (duplicate YAML keys) that was failing all 3 CI jobs. On btc-llm-sentiment, default-branch Docker build was broken by dependabot's shap 0.52.0 bump (needs Python 3.12 and later numpy>=2); re-pinned to shap==0.49.1 but a separate pre-existing tensorflow-cpu/streamlit protobuf conflict remains, so PR #71 stays open pending a streamlit>=1.46.0 bump decision. Requested @dependabot rebase on 4 conflicted dependabot PRs in kinz-secure-commerce-hub; its default-branch 'Security scans' (Trivy) job has been red since at least Oct 1 despite a prior dedicated fix (#73) -- looks like a recurring new-CVE-vs-.trivyignore gap, not a one-off regression, so left for owner review rather than guessed at. All other registry repos (analytics-service-toolkit, feed-quality-gate, kinz-competitor-intelligence, kinz-margin-guardian-pipeline, kinz-price-bridge, kinz-accounting-analysis-20260623-102129) had no open PRs, green default-branch CI, and CI already running on pull_request.
